_meta.source: 2024 Adult Compendium of Physical Activities (successor to Ainsworth et al., Compendium of Physical Activities), https://pacompendium.com/ — met_value on every row below is the Compendium's MET for the activity CODE noted in that row's own "_met_source" field, not a per-exercise measurement. Where an exercise doesn't map cleanly onto one Compendium activity, the closest matching category was used; that judgment call is noted in "_met_source" too.
todo_full_seed: Olympic lifts (clean, snatch, jerk) — no Compendium code sourced yet, do not add without one
Sled push/pull — no Compendium code sourced yet
Grip-variant pull-ups/push-ups (chin-up, wide-grip, diamond push-up) as distinct rows — currently all share code 02020
Machine chest press / machine shoulder press as distinct from free-weight bench/OHP (currently both use the general 02054 catch-all)
primary_muscles / secondary_muscles are freeform strings right now — needs a controlled vocabulary before the logbook picker filters on them
pose_config and camera_position are null on every row — needs real MediaPipe calibration data per PROJECT_GUIDE.md §11, exercise by exercise
Non-English name/instructions — only "en" is populated; add locale keys as translations become available, no migration needed

instructions.en: Bar racked across the upper back, feet shoulder-width. Squat until hips drop below knee level, then drive back up.

exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02052, 5.0 — "Resistance (weight) training, squats, deadlift, slow or explosive effort"

instructions.en: Hold a dumbbell vertically at chest height. Squat between the knees, keeping the torso upright, then stand.

exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02052, 5.0 — "Resistance (weight) training, squats, deadlift, slow or explosive effort"

instructions.en: Feet shoulder-width, no load. Squat down until thighs are roughly parallel to the floor, then stand.

exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02056, 3.0 — "Body weight resistance exercises (e.g., squat, lunge, push-up, crunch), general"

instructions.en: Squat down then explode upward into a jump, landing softly back into the squat position.

exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02057, 6.5 — "Body weight resistance exercises (e.g., squat, lunge, push-up, crunch), high intensity"

instructions.en: Bar over midfoot, hinge at the hips to grip it, then stand by driving the floor away, keeping the bar close to the shins.

exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02052, 5.0 — "Resistance (weight) training, squats, deadlift, slow or explosive effort"

instructions.en: Holding the bar, push the hips back with a slight knee bend until a stretch is felt in the hamstrings, then return to standing.

exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02052, 5.0 — "Resistance (weight) training, squats, deadlift, slow or explosive effort"

instructions.en: Hinge and hike the kettlebell back between the legs, then snap the hips forward to swing it to chest height.

form_cues: power from the hips, not the arms
exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02040, 7.5 — "Circuit training, including kettlebells, some aerobic movement with minimal rest, general, vigorous intensity"

instructions.en: Step forward into a lunge until the rear knee nearly touches the floor, then drive up and step through into the next lunge.

exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02022, 3.8 — "Calisthenics (e.g., pushups, sit ups, pull-ups, lunges), moderate effort"

instructions.en: Rear foot elevated on a bench, front foot forward. Lower until the rear knee nearly touches the floor, then drive up through the front leg.

exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02052, 5.0 — closest sourced category is "squats... slow or explosive effort"; this is a loaded single-leg squat-pattern variant, not a literal squat, so treat this mapping as approximate

instructions.en: Lying on a flat bench, lower the bar to the chest, then press it back up to full arm extension.

exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02054, 3.5 — "Resistance (weight) training, multiple exercises, 8-15 reps at varied resistance" (general catch-all; the Compendium has no bench-press-specific code)

instructions.en: Plank position, hands under shoulders. Lower the chest to the floor, then push back up to full arm extension.

exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02020, 7.5 — "Calisthenics (e.g., pushups, sit ups, pull-ups, jumping jacks, burpees, battling ropes), vigorous effort"

instructions.en: Bar at the shoulders, press it straight overhead to full arm extension, then lower back to the shoulders.

form_cues: ribs down, no excessive lean back
bar path stays close to the face
exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02054, 3.5 — "Resistance (weight) training, multiple exercises, 8-15 reps at varied resistance" (general catch-all; no press-specific code)

instructions.en: Hinge forward holding the bar, pull it into the lower ribs while keeping the torso still, then lower under control.

form_cues: pull to the ribs not the neck
exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02054, 3.5 — "Resistance (weight) training, multiple exercises, 8-15 reps at varied resistance" (general catch-all; no row-specific code)

instructions.en: Seated at the machine, pull the bar down to the upper chest, then let it rise back under control.

exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02054, 3.5 — "Resistance (weight) training, multiple exercises, 8-15 reps at varied resistance" (general catch-all; no pulldown-specific code)

instructions.en: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip, pull the chin above the bar, then lower under control to full arm extension.

exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02020, 7.5 — "Calisthenics (e.g., pushups, sit ups, pull-ups, jumping jacks, burpees, battling ropes), vigorous effort"

instructions.en: Pick up a heavy dumbbell in each hand and walk a set distance keeping the torso tall and shoulders back.

exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02050, 6.0 — closest sourced category is "power lifting or body building, vigorous effort"; the Compendium has no loaded-carry code

instructions.en: Forearms and toes on the floor, body in a straight line from head to heels. Hold the position.

exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02024, 2.8 — "Calisthenics (e.g., curl ups, abdominal crunches, plank), light effort"

instructions.en: Lying on the back, knees bent, curl the shoulders off the floor toward the hips, then lower under control.

exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02024, 2.8 — "Calisthenics (e.g., curl ups, abdominal crunches, plank), light effort"

instructions.en: Seated, torso leaned back slightly, feet off the floor. Rotate the torso side to side, touching the floor beside the hips.

exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02024, 2.8 — "Calisthenics (e.g., curl ups, abdominal crunches, plank), light effort"

instructions.en: Lying on the back, arms up and knees bent at 90 degrees. Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor, keeping the low back pressed down, then return and switch.

form_cues: low back stays on the floor
exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02024, 2.8 — "Calisthenics (e.g., curl ups, abdominal crunches, plank), light effort"

instructions.en: Standing, dumbbells at the sides. Curl the weights toward the shoulders, then lower under control.

form_cues: elbows stay pinned to the sides
exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02054, 3.5 — "Resistance (weight) training, multiple exercises, 8-15 reps at varied resistance" (general catch-all; no curl-specific code)

instructions.en: Facing a cable machine, elbows pinned to the sides. Push the bar down to full extension, then let it rise under control.

exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02054, 3.5 — "Resistance (weight) training, multiple exercises, 8-15 reps at varied resistance" (general catch-all; no pushdown-specific code)

instructions.en: Standing, dumbbells at the sides. Raise the arms out to shoulder height, then lower under control.

form_cues: lead with the elbows not the hands
exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02054, 3.5 — "Resistance (weight) training, multiple exercises, 8-15 reps at varied resistance" (general catch-all; no lateral-raise-specific code)

instructions.en: Seated at the machine, pad against the shins. Extend the knees to full extension, then lower under control.

exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02054, 3.5 — "Resistance (weight) training, multiple exercises, 8-15 reps at varied resistance" (general catch-all; no leg-extension-specific code)

instructions.en: Standing on the balls of the feet on a platform, rise up onto the toes, then lower the heels below the platform.

exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02054, 3.5 — "Resistance (weight) training, multiple exercises, 8-15 reps at varied resistance" (general catch-all; no calf-raise-specific code)

instructions.en: From standing, drop into a squat, kick the feet back to a plank, do a push-up, jump the feet back in, then jump up.

form_cues: keep a flat back in the plank
exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02020, 7.5 — "Calisthenics (e.g., pushups, sit ups, pull-ups, jumping jacks, burpees, battling ropes), vigorous effort" (burpee named explicitly)

instructions.en: Plank position. Drive the knees alternately toward the chest at a fast, running-like pace.

exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02032, 6.0 — "Circuit training, body weight exercises"

instructions.en: Sustained running at a comfortable, conversational pace.

exercises._met_source: Compendium code 12020, 7.5 — "Jogging, general, self-selected pace"

instructions.en: Sustained running at roughly a 10 minute/mile pace (6 mph).

exercises._met_source: Compendium code 12050, 9.3 — "Running, 6-6.3 mph (10 min/mile)"

instructions.en: Walking at a purposeful, exercise pace of roughly 3.5-3.9 mph.

exercises._met_source: Compendium code 17200, 4.8 — "Walking, 3.5 to 3.9 mph, level, brisk, firm surface, walking for exercise"

instructions.en: Turn the rope with the wrists and hop over it with small, low jumps at a steady rhythm.

form_cues: turn the rope with the wrists not the arms
exercises._met_source: Compendium code 02068, 11.0 — "Rope skipping exercise, general"

instructions.en: Drive with the legs, then lean back and pull the handle to the lower ribs, reversing the sequence to return.

form_cues: reverse the order on the way back
